requirement: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its evidence detail page, and each rendered requirement and example MUST be followed by a "See evidence" link to that page. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and, when an index exists, to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
rationale:
I found no gap. Each obligation has code carrying it out and a test that asserts the outcome. **Definition badge links to its detail page.** - `src/lib.rs#fn[replace_definitions]` computes `detail_href` from `plan.detail_path` and `chapter_href`. It renders the badge as an `` with the anchored id `habeas--`. The anchor comes from `src/lib.rs#impl[DefinitionKind]/fn[anchor]`. - `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` asserts `id="habeas-{kind}-rules.{name}" href="{href}"` for two requirements and one example. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts the same for `requirements.core.ready`. **Each rendered requirement or example is followed by a "See evidence" link.** - `replace_definitions` appends `

See evidence

` after the body. - `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` asserts that paragraph for each of the three definitions and that "See evidence" appears exactly 3 times. **Detail page links back to the anchored definition badge.** - `src/index.rs#fn[render_detail_page]` emits `[View definition](chapter_href(detail_path, definition.path, anchor))`. - Both of the tests above check the link, including `#habeas-req-rules.zeta`. **Detail page links to the index when one exists.** - `render_detail_page` adds `[Requirements index](…)` only when `index_path` is `Some`. - `index_shows_evidence_states_and_links_generated_chapters` asserts the link is present. - `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` asserts it is absent when there is no index. **Reference badges continue to link to the definition.** - `src/lib.rs#fn[reference_badge]` builds the href to the target definition's anchor, and `fn[replace_inline_references]` calls it. - `references_in_nested_chapters_link_to_the_requirement_definition` asserts the `href="../requirements.html#habeas-req-requirements.ready"` link for `impl`, `cite`, and `test` badges. **Links resolve when a name contains `.md`.** - `src/lib.rs#fn[chapter_href]` rewrites `.md` to `%2Emd`. - `links_preserve_requirement_names_containing_md` asserts the exact hrefs for `requirements.cli.mdbook`, for both the detail link and the definition link. - `every_definition_gets_a_nested_detail_page_without_an_index` also covers the badge, the See evidence link, and the View definition link for `rules.cli.mdbook`. **Other marked code.** - `src/index.rs#impl[DetailPlan]/fn[populate]` inserts the generated detail pages into the book. - `src/index.rs#impl[DetailPlan]/fn[is_detail_path]` is a predicate that `preprocess_book` uses to skip detail pages. It adds no distinct behavior that the text fails to cover.

text: Each requirement and example definition badge MUST link to its evidence detail page, and each rendered requirement and example MUST be followed by a "See evidence" link to that page. Each detail page MUST link back to the definition's anchored badge and, when an index exists, to the index. Reference badges MUST continue to link to the definition. These links MUST resolve when a requirement name contains `.md`, as in `requirements.cli.mdbook`.
